subject: general
question:
Which of the given letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the following series to make it logically complete?

YCG 18 HLP 23 QUY 28 ZDH 33 ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afee1750b8aae8b3cd66575fb29639fdea2e4a8545f4bc6081fde6db276d11ca.png] 

Logic followed here is:

Each letter in the cluster is shifted forward by 9 positions in the alphabetical series, and the numbers are increased by 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49fcf111856352a996cb4d4ed581d9fb463e019815ff0aaa284c496ad6eb752c.png] 

 

Therefore, the cluster that replaces the question mark is **IMQ 38**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
